name: Animethon
organizer: Alberta Society for Asian Popular Arts (ASAPA)
blurb: Canada's longest-running anime convention, a volunteer-run festival in Edmonton with a nightly Asian-pop Music Fes, AMV programming, voice-actor and VTuber guests.
notes: The homepage already shows the next edition's dates (Aug 6-8, 2027), but /guest/ still lists the just-finished 2026 edition's roster (confirmed by a web search: Animethon 2026 ran Aug 7-9, 2026 with exactly this cast -- Erica Mendez, Kenji Nojima, Alan Lee, Daoko, Who-ya Extended, Minori Chihara, The 404s -- i.e. before today, 2026-10-05), so per the stale-lineup rule no guests are recorded for 2027 (guests=none-yet). Two 'Industry Guests' cards (a 'DAN DA DAN Booth' and a 'Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid' card, linking to /guest/dandadan/ and /guest/all-works-maid/) are show/exhibitor promotions rather than people and would have been skipped even if the edition had been current. No usable logo or dedicated key-art banner was found (ogImage is empty and the only brand mark is a thin wordmark PNG), so that wordmark is used for cover rather than the homepage's hero photo, which is of a specific past guest (filename 'Ai_Furihata', a 2023-dated voice-actress photo).
